name: facebook_sdk_bridge
summary: Godot autoload (class FacebookSDKBridge) with two execution paths. Web builds inject https://connect.facebook.net/en_US/sdk.js via JavaScriptBridge.eval and call FB.init({appId, version}) using FB_APP_ID from ProjectSettings('application/config/facebook_app_id'). Mobile / desktop are signal-only stubs — each call emits pending_native_call(method, args) for phase-2 Android/iOS native plugins. Cross-process events stream to ~/.cc/godot_fb_events.jsonl.
engine_pattern: Singleton Node autoload. _ready() reads FB_APP_ID from ProjectSettings; if empty, push_warning + abort. init() branches on OS.has_feature('web'). Web path uses an idempotent JS snippet guarded by window.__mspc_fb_sdk_injected. Native path emits pending_native_call signals for Tom to wire up later.

env_vars.FB_APP_ID: Facebook App ID — read from ProjectSettings 'application/config/facebook_app_id' (NOT from raw env at runtime). Set per-project in editor or via cc tool.

project_settings.application/config/facebook_app_id: string — empty disables the bridge entirely

web.mechanism: JavaScriptBridge.eval injects SDK script tag + window.fbAsyncInit -> FB.init

native.behavior: All public methods emit pending_native_call(method, args) and return early
phase_2_targets: Android FB SDK aar via GodotAndroidPlugin
iOS FB SDK via Swift plugin

cross_process_events.schema: { ts: float, event: str, details: dict }

outbound_calls: JavaScriptBridge.eval(FB SDK injection + FB.* calls) — web only

guarantees: Graceful no-op when FB_APP_ID is empty — every method returns early with push_warning
Idempotent SDK injection — guarded by window.__mspc_fb_sdk_injected
Native callers always get a signal back via pending_native_call (no silent drops)
All calls journaled to ~/.cc/godot_fb_events.jsonl for cc side audit
blockers_phase_2: Android FB SDK GodotAndroidPlugin wrapping com.facebook.FacebookSdk
iOS FB SDK Swift plugin for Game Center / login flow
OAuth callback URI registration in Facebook developer dashboard
